description: Four tracks of thirty-two steps, each cell carrying its own pitch, probability, division, ratchets and two spare voltages

params.text: Advances every track by one step
Sends every track back to its first step
Moves the step that track starts from; a polyphonic cable at the input sets all four
Sets how many steps that track plays before it starts over; a polyphonic cable at the input sets all four
Sets the direction that track travels through its steps; a polyphonic cable at the input sets all four
Sets how much a randomise changes the cells
Fills that track with random cells; a polyphonic cable at the input randomises all four
Sets the root note the pitch output is quantised to
Sets the scale the pitch output is quantised to; the last setting leaves the pitch alone
Shifts the pitch output by whole octaves, -5 to +7
Sets how wide a spread of pitches the cell pitch knobs cover, 0V to 10V
Sets that setting at random in every cell at once
Turns the gates on and off at random across every cell
Puts that setting back to its starting value in every cell at once
Sets the pitch of the cell now selected
Sets the octave of the cell now selected
Sets the first spare voltage the cell now selected sends
Sets the second spare voltage the cell now selected sends
Sets how likely the cell now selected is to fire
Sets how often the cell now selected plays: every time at 1, every other time at 2, and so on
Sets how many times the cell now selected retriggers within its step
Sets how many gates a random pass leaves on
Turns every cell of that track off; a polyphonic cable at the input clears all four
Runs a game of life over the grid, so the pattern breeds and dies on its own

inputs.text: Advances every track by one step
Sends every track back to its first step
Moves the step that track starts from; a polyphonic cable at the input sets all four
Fills that track with random cells; a polyphonic cable at the input randomises all four
Turns the gates on and off at random across every cell
Turns every cell of that track off; a polyphonic cable at the input clears all four
Sets how many steps that track plays before it starts over; a polyphonic cable at the input sets all four
Sets the direction that track travels through its steps; a polyphonic cable at the input sets all four
A voltage here seeds the random number generator, so the same voltage always gives the same result from a randomise

outputs.text: The pitch of the cell that track is on
A gate when the cell that track is on fires, split into its ratchets
A trigger each time that track reaches the end of its own length
The first spare voltage of the cell that track is on
The second spare voltage of the cell that track is on
A trigger when the game of life stops changing

notes: clicking a cell selects it, and the pitch, octave, probability, division, ratchet and CV knobs then work on that cell
double-clicking a cell turns it on or off
holding shift and dragging across the grid paints cells on or off
menu: Gate Length — sets how long the gate outputs last, in milliseconds
Track Length — sets the length that Set All Track Lengths To Selected hands out
Set All Track Lengths To Selected — gives every track the length set on the Track Length slider
Minimum Probability — sets the lowest probability a randomise will give a cell
Copy Cell — copies the settings of the selected cell
Paste Cell — writes the copied settings into the selected cell
Polyphonic Outputs On First Row — gathers all four tracks into the first row's outputs, a channel each
CV Range — sets the range of the CV output: +/-10V, +/-5V, +/-3V, +/-2V, +/-1V, 0-10V, 0-5V, 0-3V, 0-2V or 0-1V
CV2 Range — sets the range of the CV2 output, from the same list of ranges
Grid Shading — chooses which cell setting the grid shading shows: Probability, Pitch, CV, CV2, Ratchets or Division
Game of Life Rate — sets how many clock ticks pass between one generation of the game of life and the next
Orange, Yellow, Purple and Blue — each opens Repeat track length across all steps, Copy and Paste for that track
